Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on a DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet stating Montagnana as the place of death and did not open or verify authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia, IMDb, Wikidata). Despite Planner’s instructions to cross-check, WebSurfer repeatedly performed similar searches and referenced snippets instead of drilling into pages to resolve the Rome vs. Montagnana discrepancy, leading to an incorrect or unresolved conclusion.
